dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Exactly! I've heard that they usually deal in silks and satins, but I didn't expect them to also want in on that Chasm Mora as well.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Also, I never expected Muning to have monetary connections to the Feiyun Commerce Guild. This is a great opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: So, uh... could you tell me a bit about the details behind their development plans?
